## Course sites & tutorials

- [Introduction to R](https://johnmuschelli.com/intro_to_r/), course materials
- [Faculty Office Hour](https://johnmuschelli.com/Faculty_Office_Hour/)
- [Imaging in R](https://johnmuschelli.com/imaging_in_r/) (aka Neurohacking 2.0)
- [Neurohacking](https://www.coursera.org/learn/neurohacking) on Coursera
- [Building R Packages](https://johnmuschelli.com/smi_2019/) (ENAR 2020 short course)
- [Neuroconductor tutorials](https://johnmuschelli.com/neuroc/) and a
  [worked fMRI task-processing example](https://johnmuschelli.com/talks/fmri_task_processing/index.html#1)
